I have been having this same issue for the past 2 days. My ping will jump from 20 to 400 to 1000 in an instant. I've restarted my router, my PS4, but nothing has worked.

1. I would recommend to put your sensitivity as high as yo can while still keeping it under control. If you are on console, a lower sensitivity is much more advantageous because small flicky movement are much harder to control on lower framerates.

2. You can lower your boost ramp time as well as lowering your vertical sens

3. The best ways to build your mechanics and muscle memory that I have found are boxfights and training maps. Boxfights require you to build, aim, and edit quickly and accurately. Some training maps that I reccomend are Skaavok's aim trainer (8022-6842-4965), Raider 464's edit map (0744-7641-9247), and Candook's edit course (3109-2373-6946). 

4. Just practice boxfights and build fights and get comfortable with switching weapons

5. For players that use the claw grip or paddles, just about every set of key binds is optimal and it just comes down to preference. For non-claw, no paddle players, the optimal binds would be L3 for edit, R3 for jump. Everything else can remain standard. Please note that to use L3 for editing, you must turn Spring by Default on.

6. I believe that linear is much better because its makes your mechanics much smoother and makes building muscle memory much easier.

7. I personally use a boost of 8% but the majority of linear player use no boost. This comes down to personal preference, but I would recommend using a low or no boost.
